premise: In a race across the rock pool Shrimp is too slow paddling forwards, so she curls up, flicks her tail and zooms to the finish backwards.
inspiration: Aesop's race fables (the hare and the tortoise) turned sideways: the smallest wins by doing it her own way, without even looking.
lesson: Your own way can be the fastest way.
learning: A shrimp zooms backwards by flicking its tail.

en-US.title: Backwards Shrimp
en-US.text: [excited] A race across the rock pool! {crab:enter} Crab was ready, {crab:face happy} claws up. {octopus:enter} Octopus was ready, all eight arms wiggling. And little {shrimp:enter} Shrimp was ready too. {shrimp:pulse} Ready, steady… GO! {crab:go to pool another} Crab scuttled off sideways. {octopus:go to pool another} Octopus whooshed away. Shrimp paddled forwards with her tiny legs, paddle, paddle, paddle… {shrimp:face sad} but she was SO slow. [short pause] Then she had an idea. {shrimp:live hold} Shrimp curled up tight, {sfx:flick} and FLICK! {shrimp:live resume} She snapped out her fan tail and zoomed… backwards! Zip, zip, zip! Backwards past Octopus, {octopus:face surprised} backwards past Crab, {crab:face surprised} backwards all the way across the pool. {shrimp:face happy} {shrimp:sparkle} [laughs] Shrimp had won, without even looking where she was going. {crab:live} Crab clicked his claws and danced. {octopus:hearts} [playfully] That's how shrimps go fastest, said Octopus. Backwards!

es-ES.title: La gamba que iba hacia atrás
es-ES.text: [excited] ¡Una carrera de punta a punta de la charca! {crab:enter} Cangrejo estaba listo, {crab:face happy} con las pinzas en alto. {octopus:enter} Pulpo estaba listo, con sus ocho brazos meneándose. Y la pequeña {shrimp:enter} Gamba también estaba lista. {shrimp:pulse} Preparados, listos… ¡YA! {crab:go to pool another} Cangrejo salió de lado. {octopus:go to pool another} Pulpo salió zumbando. Gamba nadaba hacia delante con sus patitas, chap, chap, chap… {shrimp:face sad} pero iba TAN despacio. [short pause] Entonces tuvo una idea. {shrimp:live hold} Gamba se hizo una bolita, {sfx:flick} y ¡FLIC! {shrimp:live resume} Estiró de repente su cola de abanico y salió disparada… ¡hacia atrás! ¡Zis, zis, zis! Hacia atrás, pasó a Pulpo, {octopus:face surprised} hacia atrás pasó a Cangrejo, {crab:face surprised} hacia atrás cruzó toda la charca. {shrimp:face happy} {shrimp:sparkle} [laughs] Gamba había ganado, sin mirar siquiera por dónde iba. {crab:live} Cangrejo chocó las pinzas y bailó. {octopus:hearts} [playfully] Así es como las gambas van más rápido, dijo Pulpo. ¡Hacia atrás!

flick.prompt: a quick little flick and splash of water in a rock pool, realistic
